name: zcode-git-worktrees
description: Git worktree support for ZCode — parallel, isolated work with safety guarantees.

plugins.name: git-worktrees
plugins.description: Git worktree support for ZCode: create, list, inspect, remove, and clean up isolated worktrees with carry-over of ignored files (.worktreeinclude), snapshots before deletion, retention sweeps, PR checkouts, background agent tasks, and automatic per-session worktrees.
